subject.facility_name: WATERBURY CENTER FOR NURSING & REHABILITATION LLC

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $155.69 per resident day (41.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 4.5% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $441,281, 6.9% of the $6,355,553 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,111,766, $27.23 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $563,713 (50.7%), allocated fringe $199,545 (17.9%), non-wage costs $348,508 (31.3%). Raw food was $310,525 ($7.61 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $947.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $505,963, $12.39 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $330,434 (65.3%), allocated fringe $116,968 (23.1%), non-wage costs $58,561 (11.6%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $307,140, $7.52 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $134,160 (43.7%), allocated fringe $47,490 (15.5%), non-wage costs $125,490 (40.9%).
Missing data: cost years 2017, 2019 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
